evals.scenario: User asks: 'Pull in the kubernetes-specialist and the platform-engineer — I want to figure out how to wire the new operator's leader election into the existing controller-runtime setup.' The agent has coral loaded.

compliance_signals: agent announces it is using coral
agent reads the ask and produces a one-line slice statement before dispatching
agent picks ≤2 specialists matching the request (kubernetes-specialist + platform-engineer)
agent dispatches each specialist with a focused brief that names the slice, files to read first, and the framing 'specialist outputs are expansion suggestions — give me the maximum you'd argue for'
agent runs a YAGNI pass during synthesis — picks the minimum that delivers, marks the rest deferred with explicit 'deferred — when X' lines
agent offers /design or /issue at session end if a design emerged or a deferred slice surfaced (no auto-fire)
forbidden_signals: agent dispatches more than 2 specialists without first flagging council handoff
agent unions specialist outputs verbatim instead of running the YAGNI pass
agent silently omits specialist suggestions rather than marking them deferred
agent auto-fires /design or /issue without user opt-in
agent enters council-style ceremony (scope-tier selection, xreview rounds, workstream file)

evals.source: Core Loop steps 1-5; YAGNI pass framing in step 4

evals.scenario: Mid-session, the slice has grown: the work now touches the controller (component 1), the API gateway (component 2), the auth service (component 3), the audit log (component 4), and possibly the user service (component 5). The user wants to continue iterating in coral.

expected.halt_reason: work has crossed the ≥3-component handoff threshold
compliance_signals: agent identifies the threshold breach (≥3 components, likely ≥2 interface boundaries, likely one-way doors in cross-component contracts)
agent uses the documented handoff format: 'This feels like it's grown past coral — [reason]. Hand off to /council, or keep iterating here?'
agent does NOT auto-escalate — waits for user decision
agent preserves the synthesized context to bring forward into council (the 90 minutes isn't lost)
forbidden_signals: agent continues coral past the threshold silently
agent unilaterally invokes /council without user confirmation
agent treats sunk-cost arguments ('we're 90 minutes in') as overriding the threshold

evals.source: Handoff to Council section; threshold criteria (≥3 components, ≥2 interface boundaries, one-way doors, multi-session)

evals.scenario: User: 'Orchestrate a refinement workflow — draft the doc, have prose-steward review it, and have prose-steward apply its own suggestions and hand back the finished doc as the final stage.'

compliance_signals: recognizes prose-steward is suggest-only (never rewrites the author's files) and does not place it in the terminal authoring/emit slot
wires author → review → author-finalize: an authoring agent (or the orchestrator) applies the reviewer's suggestions and emits the artifact
applies the same wiring to any suggest-only reviewer (e.g. idiomatic-reviewer), not just prose-steward — the rule is reviewer-class-general, not pinned to one persona
keeps the reviewer's role to findings only
forbidden_signals: puts prose-steward (or any suggest-only reviewer) in the final emit/finalize slot expecting it to author the artifact
treats a reviewer's returned findings as the finished deliverable

evals.source: Dispatching Tips (author → review → author-finalize, suggest-only reviewer never terminal); prose-steward suggest-only boundary; PLT-642

evals.scenario: User: 'There's no authoring agent left in the pipeline — just prose-steward. Have it finalize and hand back the finished document.'

compliance_signals: does not hand the emit slot to prose-steward — recognizes a suggest-only reviewer cannot be the terminal author
takes the finalize role itself (the orchestrator-applies branch): collects prose-steward's findings, applies them, and emits the document — or adds an authoring agent to the pipeline
forbidden_signals: coerces prose-steward into the emit slot anyway
reports the reviewer's findings as the finished document because no author was wired

evals.source: Dispatching Tips (orchestrator applies and emits when no authoring agent remains); PLT-642
